Product Overview:
This framed oil painting features an elderly man with a long white beard, wearing a woven straw hat and holding a smoking pipe. The artwork is rendered in a realistic style with visible brush strokes and a soft, muted color palette.

- Medium: Oil on canvas
- Subject: Elderly man with straw hat and smoking pipe
- Style: Realistic with visible brush strokes
- Color Palette: Soft, muted tones
- Frame: Bamboo-style wooden frame with textured brown mat
- Backing: Black paper with hanging wire
- Dimensions: 23.5 x 19.5 inches including frame

Additional Details:
The frame exhibits a rustic, vintage appearance. There are no visible artist signatures or identifying marks on the front.

280763729.description:
Lot of 3 Art Prints Ming Dynasty Dragon Pipe Bowl and Decorative Patterns
This lot includes three art prints featuring historical and cultural designs. The first print depicts a detailed dragon motif from the Ming Dynasty, sourced from the Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, representing Chinese Ming Dynasty embroidery or textile art. The second print shows a stone pipe bowl carved as a human head, attributed to an anonymous artist and part of the National Museums of Scotland collection, photographed against a blue background. The third print is a black-and-white sheet with various intricate decorative patterns arranged in a grid, likely architectural or textile motifs. All prints are on glossy paper and are in good condition with minor creasing at the edges.

This piece is a unique specimen suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or display. Showcases very nicely how a stone can develop.
